head: LifeSize prints any photo as a big poster on normal paper
dek: LifeSize turns photos, pets and drawings into large cutouts and posters printed on ordinary printer paper: pick a size, see the page count, follow the numbered sections. It was #56 among paid Graphics & Design apps on the US App Store on 4 November.
details: It costs $3.99 with in-app purchases, by Aaron Lincoln.
means: If you want a life-size cutout for a party, you can print it at home.
todo: Find LifeSize in the App Store.
